integrity: The proof is analytic: barycentric inequalities give the exact eroded simplex, and the width identity follows from an explicit polar description of the simplex difference body. No finite computation or numerical certificate is used to infer the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem evaluates the directional Minkowski-subtraction minimum for simplices and classifies its minimizers. It does not prove that a single plank attains this erosion bound for every higher-dimensional simplex, so the general partial-plank conjecture remains open.
title: Bang's homothetic core is exact for every simplex
